metadata.title: Happy Horse AI Video Edit | Transform Existing Clips
metadata.description: Edit existing clips in Happy Horse AI with prompt-driven changes, short clip presets, and AI audio or original audio options.
metadata.keywords: happy horse ai video edit, ai video editing, prompt video edit, edit existing video with ai

hero.title: Happy Horse AI Video Edit
hero.description: Upload an existing clip, describe the change you want, and choose whether to keep original audio or switch to AI audio. This workflow is built for prompt-led video revisions.

tabs.label: Video Edit
tabs.placeholder: Describe the edits you want to make...

workflow.title: What the video edit workflow covers
workflow.description: Use this mode when you already have a clip and want to revise content, direction, or presentation without starting from zero.

items.title: Upload an existing clip
items.description: Start from a source video rather than a prompt-only idea or a single image.

items.title: Prompt-led revisions
items.description: Describe the change you want instead of rebuilding the scene in a separate editor.

items.title: Clip length presets
items.description: Choose a full clip edit or shorter 5-second and 10-second presets depending on the use case.

items.title: Audio handling options
items.description: Pick AI audio or keep original audio when the source clip already contains the sound you want.

items.title: Reference image support
items.description: Add a reference image when the edit needs a specific visual direction or character style.

items.title: 720p and 1080p output
items.description: Export the edited clip at the resolution that fits either testing speed or final delivery.

steps.label: How It Works
steps.title: Revise existing clips in three steps
steps.description: Keep the source clip strong, then use the prompt and audio choices to control how much the output changes.

items.title: Upload the source clip
items.description: Start with the video you want to transform, plus an optional reference image for added direction.

items.title: Describe the edit
items.description: Explain the content or style change and choose full, 5-second, or 10-second processing.

items.title: Choose audio and export
items.description: Keep original audio or switch to AI audio before generating the edited result.

faq.title: Video Edit FAQ
faq.description: Questions about editing existing clips in Happy Horse AI.

items.question: What can I upload to the video edit workflow?
items.answer: You can upload an existing video clip and optionally add a reference image to guide the visual direction of the edit.

items.question: Can I keep the original audio?
items.answer: Yes. The workflow includes an option to keep the original audio instead of switching to AI audio.

items.question: What duration options are available?
items.answer: Video edit supports a full-clip option plus shorter 5-second and 10-second presets.

items.question: When should I use video edit instead of reference-to-video?
items.answer: Use video edit when you already have a clip that needs revision. Use reference-to-video when you want to generate a new clip guided by source materials.
